pages.text: Parent order does not matter. Each matching recipe has a 20% chance to mutate; failures produce one parent fly.$(br2)These are the current breeding routes.

pages.title: Base Routes 1
pages.text: $(li)Black + Yellow = Brown$(li)Green + Blue = Cyan$(li)Purple + Pink = Magenta$(li)Red + Blue = Purple$(li)Red + Green = Yellow$(li)Red + Yellow = Orange$(li)White + Black = Gray$(li)White + Blue = Light Blue$(li)White + Gray = Light Gray$(li)White + Green = Lime$(li)White + Red = Pink

pages.title: Base Routes 2
pages.text: $(li)Purple + Cyan = Ender$(li)Green + Yellow = Dragon Fruit$(li)Dragon Fruit + Yellow = Glowstone$(li)White + Orange = Copper$(li)Light Gray + Copper = Iron$(li)Glowstone + Copper = Gold$(li)Lime + Gold = Emerald$(li)Gold + Emerald = Diamond$(li)Emerald + Diamond = Netherite$(li)Normal + Copper = Black

pages.title: Integration Recipes
pages.text: These recipes require their mods to be loaded:$(br2)$(li)Cyan + Iron = Zinc [Create]$(li)Light Blue + Diamond = Certus [AE2]$(li)Black + Glowstone = Sky Dust [AE2]$(li)Light Gray + Iron = Tin [Mekanism]$(li)Iron + Tin = Lead [Mekanism]$(li)Diamond + Lead = Osmium [Mekanism]$(li)Dragon Fruit + Emerald = Uranium [Mekanism]$(li)Purple + Osmium = Fluorite [Mekanism]
